title: Block Out Level 23 Walkthrough
summary: Block Out Level 23 is a knot board with two framed lower boxes marked `11` and `8`. Use the top blue lane and right yellow gate to untie the curled center path, then let the two boss boxes fall once the knot is gone.

variants.gameVersion: current iOS and Android catalog checked 2026-08-03

landmarks: Block Out Level 23 is a knot board with two framed lower boxes marked `11` and `8`.
Use the top blue lane and right yellow gate to untie the curled center path, then let the two boss boxes fall once the knot is gone.
The board mixes Blue, Yellow, Red and more.
The opening layout is a color-sort grid.
Clear matched tiles to finish the level.

quickTips: Untie the center before attacking the lower boxes.
The top blue route is part of the opener, not the closer.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Feed the top blue route first so the middle curl has one less blocker.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Use the right yellow lane to pull the upper yellow column away from the knot.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Rotate the red and purple curl pieces until the central path is no longer closed.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Start shrinking the framed `11` box once the left half of the knot has opened.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Let the framed `8` box fall after the right half has also cleared.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Clean up the tall red and yellow columns that were holding the curl in place.

steps.title: Move 7
steps.instruction: Finish with the last blue top route after both lower frames are nearly gone.

failurePoints: Trying to empty a lower framed box while the center curl is still tight.
Ignoring the right yellow gate and overworking only the top blue route.
